item.title: Obituary - Jimmy Greenwell
item.description: James "Jimmy" Greenwell, 72, passed away on Monday, December 1, 2025 at Golden Valley Memorial Hospital in Clinton, Missouri. Funeral services will be held at 2:00 PM on Monday, December 8, 2025 at the Vansant-Mills Chapel with visitation from 1:00-2:00 PM prior to the service. Memorial contributions can be made to the Deepwater Cemetery and may be left in care of the funeral home.

item.title: Living Nativity to return to Butler First Baptist Chuch
item.description: 2025 will mark the third year for an amazing drive-through living nativity to be held December 6 & 7 at the Butler First Baptist Church complete with baby Jesus as seen here from the 2023 nativity.The free event will be open both nights 6-8 pm. The church is located at 300 N. Delaware street in Butler.

item.title: More donations coming in for The Wall That Heals
item.description: Dale Newkirk, Treasurer of the Republican Central Committee, presented John Gray and Jami Page a check for The Wall That Heals- thank you for being a Gold Sponsor.When the Republican Central Committee pledged their donation, they challenged the Democrat Central Committee to do the same!The Wall That Heals will be on display in Butler for four days, beginning April 30, 2026.
